notes.title: Major Update Information 2018/1/6
notes.content:
We have repaired a major loophole. This vulnerability is caused by the delay in artificial intelligence. This makes the orbit simulation inaccurate, and the box will eventually hit the gravitational body. The celebration was that we found it in time and repaired it perfectly.
Also, we redesigned most of the UI, and it became very sci-fi.
